content_text: Your opinion is as relevant as any other. As I said to the director, I would like to see a film that deals with the ‘between the  wars’ period, after Versailles. War itself can be ‘entertaining’ on film (‘Top Gun’ and the rest) but is less interesting than the sociological reasons that lead up to it and the consequences that follow when the fighting stops.
